title: Revert L2 finality to PERMISSIONED_CANNON
summary: Flip the AnchorStateRegistry's respected game type back to 1 (the playground default).
audience: Anyone who flipped to ZK and wants the original consensus method back.
description:
Mirror of `switch-to-zk-consensus` — calls `AnchorStateRegistry.setRespectedGameType(GameType.wrap(1))` from the guardian. Useful as a one-click rollback during demos.

## When to run

Any time you want to test or A/B compare finality paths. The PERMISSIONED_CANNON impl is unchanged across these flips — only the registry state changes.

prerequisites.title: Guardian key
prerequisites.detail: Same OP_PG_GUARDIAN_PRIVKEY as the forward switch.

produces.title: Consensus panel reverts
produces.detail: ACTIVE flips back to PERMISSIONED_CANNON within 10s
